content: MK reports that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn had long since fallen afoul of the Damascene traditionist Muḥammad al-Jazarī (d. 833/1429) and the orthodox Sufi Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī (d. 838/1435), eponym of the Zayniyya of Herat, whom he dismisses in Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I as mafiosos and backbiters, people of little learning but many designs and the plague of true scholars.
refers_to_primary: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I, 187 (as reported by MK)
